critical_illness.value: Lump sum of the critical illness sum assured on first diagnosis of any of 40 specified illnesses, if the life assured survives the survival period. 90 day waiting period. The rider then ends.

rider_term.value: Limited pay 6 to 20 years; regular pay 5 to 20 years; not beyond the base policy term or age 70.

premium_paying_rules.value: Limited pay 5 to 19 years or regular pay (same as policy term). Annual, semi-annual, quarterly or monthly. Opted at inception only. Rider premium at most 100% of the base premium.

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 50,000. Maximum Rs 50,00,000 or the base policy sum assured, whichever is lower.

premium_deduction.note: Not stated in the brochure text read. Needs a second read.
